:::{#exm-measurable-space}
#### Measurable spaces of die rolls

For the die rolls $D = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$:

- $(D, \mathscr{S})$, with $\mathscr{S}$ the collection of all subsets of $D$,
  is a measurable space (@exm-sigma-algebra).
- $(D, \set{\emptyset, \set{2, 4, 6}, \set{1, 3, 5}, D})$ is also a measurable space.
  Its measurable sets are only those four;
  for example, $\set{1}$ is not one of them.

:::
